name: ILI9341 3.2" SPI TFT
verify: 14-pin header assumed along the bottom edge, VCC at the left seen from the screen side. SDO (MISO) is deliberately left unconnected: the firmware never reads the display, and some ILI9341 boards don't release MISO, which breaks the SD card on the shared bus. Touch pins (T_*) unused.
source: Modelled from common ILI9341 3.2" SPI TFT modules — not yet checked against a specific board.
